mapper.insert: insert into knowledge_draft(question, answer, category_id, source, status, created_time) values(#{question}, #{answer}, #{categoryId}, #{source}, #{status}, #{createdTime})
mapper.update:
update knowledge_draft
question = #{question},
answer = #{answer},
category_id = #{categoryId},
source = #{source},
status = #{status},
reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy},
reviewed_time = #{reviewedTime},
where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, question, answer, category_id, source, status, reviewed_by, reviewed_time, created_time from knowledge_draft where id = #{id}

select kd.id, kd.question, kd.answer, c.name as categoryName, kd.source, CASE kd.status WHEN 0 THEN '待审核' WHEN 1 THEN '已通过' END as statusDesc, kd.status, kd.created_time as createdTime, kd.reviewed_time as reviewedTime, kd.reviewed_by as reviewedBy from knowledge_draft kd left join category c on kd.category_id = c.id where kd.id = #{id}
